replace:
const versusUnlockAtBuild = opts.versusUnlock?.() ?? EVERY_BOARD_UNLOCKED;
  const versusUnlock = (): BoardUnlock => versusUnlockAtBuild;
why: Reads the unlock once, when the HUD is built, instead of on every row build. The page's HUD outlives every session, so a level cleared after boot would not reach the versus Map row until a reload, and a progress reset would leave its boards offered for the rest of the page. A tidy-looking hoist of a getter that is 'only progress', which is exactly why `HudOptions.versusUnlock` is a getter.
